seo.titulo: Automatic captions and text for client clips | Clipfine
seo.descripcion: Automatic captions with the spoken word highlighted, 9 styles, hook and call to action in each client's colors. For agencies that edit clips.

bajada: Captions come straight from the transcript, with the spoken word highlighted. The opening hook and the closing call to action use the client's colors. Your editor proofreads instead of typing.

agencia.subtitulos: The slowest part of editing a clip is done by Clipfine. Your editor just reviews it.
agencia.corregir: Fixing a misspelled client name means changing one word, with nothing to re-sync.
agencia.estilos: Each client gets a different look without designing from scratch: a viral style for one, a clean one for another.
agencia.textosDiseno: Text looks agency-made, not like a generic template, and it's built in the same editor.
agencia.gancho: The first seconds decide whether the clip gets watched. The hook comes suggested and goes on with one tap.
agencia.cta: Every clip ends by sending people to the client's episode, which is what they pay you for.

p1.p: Do I have to type the captions?
p1.r: No. They come from the episode transcript, word by word and in sync. If a word came out wrong, you change it without touching the timing.

p2.p: Can I use a different style for each client?
p2.r: Yes. Each brand has its caption and hook style, painted in its colors. You can change it on a single clip.

p3.p: Can I add text on top of the captions?
p3.r: Yes. Add text with the font, outline, shadow or box you want, with highlighted words in another color and the second it appears.
